title: Kode Dot Programmable pocket device for makers, pentesters and geeks
summary: Kode Dot is a programmable pocket-sized hardware device designed for makers, penetration testers, and technology enthusiasts to perform on-the-go security testing, hardware hacking, and custom automation tasks without needing a full laptop setup.
problem_solved: Provides a portable, dedicated tool for security professionals and makers to execute programmable tasks and security tests in the field without carrying bulky equipment.
why_valuable: It offers mobility and convenience for security researchers and hobbyists who need quick access to programmable hardware tools during penetration testing engagements or maker projects.
